It carries the same divine subject from the prior action-predicates in 85:13 into a new nominal clause, so forgiveness and love interpret the preceding beginning-and-return sequence instead of forming a detached consolation. The particle can also color the line with a while/with force, but local evidence keeps the main work as resumption and coordination: the attributes stand alongside the prior acts as character, not as a later event. In the recited unit {{ar:وَهُوَ}} ({{tr:wa-huwa}}), the connector is heard attached to the pronoun, so the boundary continuity is audible before either attribute appears.

topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify {{ar:وَهُوَ}} ({{tr:wa-huwa}}) as the start of a coordinated nominal sentence whose subject continues the prior divine referent, supporting resumption and coordination across the boundary.

topics.headline: concurrent attribute coloring

topics.reason: The surface sequence supports reading {{ar:وَهُوَ}} ({{tr:wa-huwa}}) as an audible boundary hinge that introduces the same subject.

words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) supplies an explicit subject where the context could have carried the referent silently. That retained independent pronoun points back through the prior chain in 85:13 and prevents the agent of beginning and returning from being split off from the one now named forgiving and loving. Because the clause is verbless, the pronoun stands directly beside {{ar:ٱلْغَفُورُ}} ({{tr:al-ghafūru}}) and {{ar:ٱلْوَدُودُ}} ({{tr:al-wadūdu}}): the line gives settled identity, not a report of one new event. The local reprise of {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) across 85:13-85:14 turns the ayah into a compact referential hinge.

topics.headline: same subject made explicit
topics.summary: The independent pronoun anchors both predicates to the already-known divine subject from the previous ayah.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the one who begins and returns in 85:13 is exactly the one identified by forgiveness and love in 85:14.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence says the independent pronoun continues the same masculine singular divine subject from the preceding predications; the CRITICAL rows correctly preserve this as identity focus and referent continuity.

topics.headline: verbless identity clause
topics.summary: The pronoun functions as the subject of a nominal sentence with two predicates and no overt copula.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears forgiveness and love as settled identity-predicates rather than as a one-time narrated action.
topics.reason: The local clause evidence identifies a nominal sentence with {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) as subject and the two following names as predicates, with no finite event verb.

topics.headline: pronoun reprise
topics.summary: The independent pronoun is audibly renewed across the boundary from 85:13 into 85:14.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the boundary bridge: the repeated pronoun makes the subject audible again before the attribute pair lands.
topics.reason: The rows point to the local reprise of {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) from 85:13 into {{ar:وَهُوَ}} ({{tr:wa-huwa}}) in 85:14, and the pronoun-antecedent evidence supports the same referent.

words.gloss_range: definite intensive divine-name predicate: forgiving in the sense of protective covering, pardon, and shielding from consequence
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes covering and concealment, forgiving and shielding from consequence, and several unrelated lexical branches; the local faʿūl predicate selects the forgiveness/protective-covering branch
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْغَفُورُ}} ({{tr:al-ghafūru}}) is the first definite predicate after {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}), so forgiveness is stated as recognized identity rather than incidental description. Its {{ar:غ ف ر}} ({{tr:gh-f-r}}) field keeps the image of covering inside pardon: fault is not denied, but liability and exposure are covered and shielded from consequence. The faʿūl shape makes that covering-forgiveness durable and intensive, while the broader derivative family is only a horizon: seeking, repeated forgiving, and granted pardon help explain the field, but the local word is the stable name {{ar:ٱلْغَفُورُ}} ({{tr:al-ghafūru}}), not a command or event verb. Placed after severe seizure in 85:12 and after beginning and return in 85:13, the name qualifies divine force and return with protective pardon; placed before {{ar:ٱلْوَدُودُ}} ({{tr:al-wadūdu}}), it makes covered fault the threshold into love. The familiar pairing with mercy in 39:53 is therefore locally specialized by affection, while the repentance scene in 11:90 also places affection-language near forgiveness-language; the shared faʿūl cadence makes the two names sound like one interpretive pair.

topics.headline: recognized forgiveness identity
topics.summary: The word is a definite nominative predicate of the explicit pronoun and the first member of a parallel predicate pair.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that forgiveness is built into the subject's stated identity and is grammatically paired with love.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make {{ar:ٱلْغَفُورُ}} ({{tr:al-ghafūru}}) a definite intensive predicate of {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}), parallel with {{ar:ٱلْوَدُودُ}} ({{tr:al-wadūdu}}).

topics.headline: covering as protective pardon
topics.summary: The local forgiveness sense retains the root image of covering and shielding from consequence.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that forgiveness here is not bare cancellation; it is protective covering over exposure and liability.
topics.reason: V4 supports the accepted forgiveness branch of {{ar:غ ف ر}} ({{tr:gh-f-r}}) with shielding from consequence and also preserves the older covering image; unrelated branches such as star, gum, animal, or illness relapse do not enter the local predicate.

topics.headline: durable faʿūl forgiveness
topics.summary: The faʿūl intensive form presents forgiveness as stable capacity, not a single reaction or only repeated action.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears pardon as an enduring divine capacity whose intensity matches the following love-name.
topics.reason: The local form is a definite intensive noun or name on the faʿūl pattern; the comparison with repeated-forgiving forms is useful only to show that the selected word foregrounds stable attribute-status.

topics.headline: sought and granted pardon horizon
topics.summary: Nearby derivatives show forgiveness as sought, granted, repeated, and remissive, but those forms do not replace the local divine-name predicate.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the name stands within a field where pardon can be sought and granted, while the ayah itself names the giver's settled attribute.
topics.reason: The derivative rows supply real lexical horizon for {{ar:غ ف ر}} ({{tr:gh-f-r}}), but V4 cautions that other forms are not local activation; the payoff is retained as background to the selected predicate {{ar:ٱلْغَفُورُ}} ({{tr:al-ghafūru}}).

topics.headline: severity and return qualified
topics.summary: The name answers the severe seizure frame in 85:12 and colors the return statement in 85:13 with protective forgiveness.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that divine force and return are not left as bare power; they are reread through stable covering-forgiveness.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete local references to 85:12 and 85:13, and the same-subject evidence allows the attribute to qualify the preceding divine-action frame without erasing the severity.

topics.headline: forgiveness opens into love
topics.summary: The first predicate position, local cadence, and cross-surah pairings make forgiveness lead into the following love-name.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not stop at covered liability; the first name prepares restored affection as the endpoint.
topics.reason: The local syntax pairs {{ar:ٱلْغَفُورُ}} ({{tr:al-ghafūru}}) with {{ar:ٱلْوَدُودُ}} ({{tr:al-wadūdu}}), while the supplied references to 39:53 and 11:90 support formulaic contrast without replacing the local partner.

words.gloss_range: definite intensive divine-name predicate of loving affection, belovedness, and desired good, locally focused as stable relational love
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes affection and loving attachment, wishing or desiring, place and idol-name branches, and a dialectal stake/peg form; the local predicate selects the affection/loving-attachment branch with wishing-good as lexical horizon
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْوَدُودُ}} ({{tr:al-wadūdu}}) is not a soft afterthought after forgiveness. It is a second definite predicate of the same {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}), unconjoined and parallel to {{ar:ٱلْغَفُورُ}} ({{tr:al-ghafūru}}), so love independently completes the identity claim. The {{ar:و د د}} ({{tr:w-d-d}}) field gives the name active relational warmth: loving, belovedness, wished good, affection, and bond-forming nearness all stand in the horizon, while local form keeps reciprocity and performed approach as coloring rather than the selected sense. Its faʿūl shape and matching long ū cadence make love as stable and intensive as forgiveness. Because it comes last, the ayah lands beyond a cleared ledger: covered fault opens into positive relation, and the agent of beginning in 85:13 is heard as one whose settled character includes desired good and warm relation. The supplied parallels sharpen that endpoint: 11:90 places the same rare attribute beside mercy after repentance, 19:96 speaks of affection granted, and 85:14 names the attribute-source of that relational warmth beside forgiveness. The final d-sound also carries the attribute register forward toward the majesty language of 85:15.

topics.headline: love independently predicated
topics.summary: The word is a definite second predicate attached to the same explicit subject and not a decorative modifier.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that love completes the identity claim with the same grammatical strength as forgiveness.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence strongly licenses {{ar:ٱلْوَدُودُ}} ({{tr:al-wadūdu}}) as a parallel predicate of {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}), paired with {{ar:ٱلْغَفُورُ}} ({{tr:al-ghafūru}}).

topics.headline: apposition still subject-bound
topics.summary: An appositional reading may be noted only as an alternate route that still binds the word to the same subject.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that even a looser epithet-chain parse does not let love float free from the identified subject.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL row's appositional possibility is narrowed because the stronger local attachment marks direct parallel predication; the surviving payoff is same-subject routing under either parse.

topics.headline: affection with wished good
topics.summary: The root field supplies affection, belovedness, wished good, friendship, and nearness, while reciprocal or displayed-affection derivatives remain horizon rather than the surface sense.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears divine love as active relational warmth and desired good, not as an abstract benevolent label.
topics.reason: V4 supports affection and loving attachment as the local branch of {{ar:و د د}} ({{tr:w-d-d}}), with wishing as a related branch; derivative forms for mutual or displayed affection color the horizon but do not control the selected predicate {{ar:ٱلْوَدُودُ}} ({{tr:al-wadūdu}}).

topics.headline: love matched to forgiveness
topics.summary: The faʿūl pattern and matching cadence give love the same durable attribute-status as forgiveness.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears love as a stable matched quality, not a weaker emotional supplement to pardon.
topics.reason: The local adjective/name is a definite qualitative predicate on the same faʿūl pattern and in the same predicate frame as {{ar:ٱلْغَفُورُ}} ({{tr:al-ghafūru}}).

topics.headline: final word is love
topics.summary: Final position makes love the endpoint opened by forgiveness and turns prior action into stable loving character.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader leaves the ayah not with a neutral cleared ledger but with restored positive relation as the closing sound and sense.
topics.reason: The local order places {{ar:ٱلْوَدُودُ}} ({{tr:al-wadūdu}}) after {{ar:ٱلْغَفُورُ}} ({{tr:al-ghafūru}}) and at the ayah close, so the final predicate carries structural closure and characterizes the prior acts through love.

topics.headline: rare attribute in known pairings
topics.summary: The supplied references to 11:90 and 19:96 make the local love-name conspicuous without overriding its local pairing with forgiveness.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the attribute heard beside mercy in 11:90 and the affection granted in 19:96 are locally focused beside forgiveness as source and endpoint of relational warmth.
topics.reason: The inter-ayah rows supply concrete references to 11:90 and 19:96 and rarity pressure for the adjective, but the evidence is narrowed to echo and contrast; it does not make external pairings govern the 85:14 syntax.

topics.headline: cadence into 85:15
topics.summary: Connected recitation and the final d-sound bind the two-name pair and carry the attribute sequence toward 85:15.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the love-name close the pair while also opening the ear toward the next attribute movement in 85:15.
topics.reason: The surface and sound rows are retained as recitational and boundary payoffs: they bind {{ar:ٱلْوَدُودُ}} ({{tr:al-wadūdu}}) to the preceding name and to the following attribute sequence in 85:15.

topics.headline: compact identity seal
topics.summary: Pronoun retention, paired predicates, cadence, and co-occurrence evidence make the two-name clause a compact identity seal.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the whole clause close as a character seal: one subject, two durable paired attributes, one audible unit.
topics.reason: The synthesis rows coherently combine already-supported local facts: explicit subject, nominal architecture, parallel faʿūl predicates, cadence, and supplied co-occurrence evidence.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Pardon as shielding from consequence.** `غ ف ر` B002 supplies forgiving by covering sin and protecting its bearer from punishment; B001 supplies the underlying image of a protective covering. Coming after severe seizure and beginning/return, the pair prevents force from becoming the only description of divine relation. I infer that the cover interrupts exposure to consequence. الغفور therefore reads as active protection, not mere non-action.

2. **Positive attachment beyond pardon.** `و د د` B001 supplies affection and loving attachment. Its coordination with الغفور makes the mechanism move from removal of liability to positive relation. I infer direction from sequence: covering harm enables restored attachment. The ayah preserves two distinct acts, forgiveness and love, rather than blending them into generic kindness.

3. **Love with intended realization.** `و د د` B002 supplies wishing or desiring that something occur; 85:16 later supplies effective will (`ر و د` B001) and intensive action (`ف ع ل` B001). I infer that the desired good is not impotent sentiment when attributed to the same subject who effectively does what He wills. Exploratorily, الودود can therefore be heard as affection whose desired end can be brought about, while B001 remains the direct adjective reading.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayah 85:16's effective will changes الودود from sentiment into affection capable of realized effect, strengthening the exploratory `و د د` B002 activation while leaving B001 primary. Ayah 85:20's protective-care branch of encompassing (`ح و ط` B002) gives forgiveness's cover a larger spatial form. The later guarded tablet similarly corrects any private or ephemeral reading: pardon and attachment belong to an order that can preserve its promise.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Forgiveness as protective re-enclosure.** Lexical evidence: `غ ف ر` B001, “protective covering,” and B002, “forgiving and shielding from consequence.” Structural cue and role: the line follows exposure to fire, testimony, and severe seizure; 85:20 later uses `ح و ط` B001/B002 for surrounding and protective care. Covering supplies shelter after exposure, while forgiveness supplies release from consequence. Abductive move: I infer that the later enclosure image discloses a protective polarity of covering; the packet does not explicitly identify who is enclosed protectively. Reading change: `الغفور` becomes an active shielding and re-covering, not only cancellation of an account.

2. **Affection able to become action.** Lexical evidence: `و د د` B001, “affection and loving attachment,” coexists with B002, “wishing for something to come about”; 85:16 contributes `ر و د` B001, “will and intention,” and `ف ع ل` B001, bringing an act into being. Structural cue and role: affection is placed between begin/return and the one who effectively does what he wills. Desire supplies orientation; effective action supplies execution. Abductive move: I infer that the affection is causally efficacious rather than merely felt because it belongs to the same continuing subject; the text does not state a particular desired object. Reading change: `الودود` becomes operative attachment capable of directing restoration and protection.

3. **Enclosure retains both mercy and threat.** Lexical evidence: fixed `غ ف ر` B001 supplies protective cover, while later `ح و ط` B006 supplies overwhelming encirclement and ruin. Structural cue and role: 85:19–20 place deniers inside a larger surround, after 85:14 has named forgiveness and affection. Abductive move: I infer that the same spatial logic of being covered or surrounded can protect the reconciled and constrain persistent denial; the allocation of effects is inferred, not stated in 85:14. Reading change: forgiveness is not made sentimental or powerless; its sheltering polarity coexists with an enclosure that can also prevent escape.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 85:16 turned the wishing potential of `و د د` B002 into executable affection by joining will directly to intensive action. 85:20 was the spatial surprise: `محيط` activates both protective care and ruin, so the covering in `غ ف ر` B001 belongs to a larger two-polarity enclosure mechanism.

Sevgi, hemen sonraki etkin irade ve eylemle birleşince yalnız hissedilen değil, onarım ve koruma sonucunu gerçekleştirebilen bir bağlılık olarak görünür.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A speaker calls on the divine name, swears by it, voices a wish, and seeks ratification through “Amen.”

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak alanı ağaçla ilişkili bir ürün adıdır. Bunun sakıza benzeyen bir madde, meyve ağacı sakızı veya suyla karıştırılıp içilebilen tatlı bir kurt olarak açıklanması ve ağaçtan toplanması farklı anlatımlarda yer alır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Nesne düzeyinde çekirdek aynıdır; ancak bu dal yalnızca bölgesel kaynaşmış biçimdir. Komşu dal olağan adı, eylemi ve daha geniş bağlı kullanımları da içerdiği için sınırlar tam eşleşmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kazık nesnesini başına nasıl vurulduğuna bakmadan genel olarak bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Darbelerle başı örselenen özel bir kazık türünü bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da üzerine vurulabilen somut bir kazık nesnesine gönderme yapar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın kazık anlamında darbe sonucu oluşan bir özellik şart değildir. Komşu ise başına vurulup örselenmiş kazığı özel olarak adlandırdığı için daha dar bir sınır taşır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel kazık dalı ve darbeyle özelleşen kazık dalı doğrudan sınır karşılaştırması sağlar. Öteki adaylar farklı destek araçları, direkler, yerleştirme eylemleri veya aynı yazılıştaki ilgisiz anlamlardır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الود بمعنى الوتد في لغة تميم أو أهل نجد، على أنه لفظ مدغم أو مقلوب ذكرته المصادر داخل هذا الباب.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الوداد والمودة ولا الصنم ولا أسماء المواضع.
branches.source_phrase_ar: فأما الود فالوتد (maqayis)؛ الود لغة تميمية وهو الوتد (jamhara)؛ الود بالفتح الوتد في لغة أهل نجد كأنهم سكنوا التاء فأدغموها في الدال (sihah)؛ الود بلغة تميم الوتد (tahdhib)؛ الود: الوتد، وأصله يصح أن يكون وتد فأدغم (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi aynı köke bağlı iki biçimi, bilinen bir dağın ve bilinen bir vadinin özel adı olarak verir. Dalın birleştirici sınırı ortak bir yer türü değil, bu biçimlerin yer adı olarak kullanılmasıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca dağ ve vadiye gönderme yapan özel ad kullanımlarını kapsar; coğrafi yerlerin genel adlarını veya başka özel adları kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, çıplak biçimlerin yer adı işleviyle sınırlıdır ve aynı yazılışın sevgi, dilek, kazık ya da put anlamlarını içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir çıplak biçimin bilinen bir dağın, aynı köke bağlı başka bir çıplak biçimin ise bilinen bir vadinin özel adı olarak kullanılmasıdır.

facets.statement: Çıplak biçimin bilinen bir dağın özel adı olarak kullanılması.
Aynı köke bağlı başka bir çıplak biçimin bilinen bir vadinin özel adı olması.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak aktarımının ortak merkezi bilinen bir dağa verilen özel addır; aynı köke bağlı başka bir biçim ayrıca bilinen bir vadinin özel adı olarak kaydedilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: İki çıplak biçimin sırasıyla belirli bir dağ ve belirli bir vadi için özel ad oluşunu birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Yer türlerini ve bunların özel ad olarak kullanılmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İlk çıplak biçimin belirli bir dağa gönderme yaptığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Göndergenin dağ oluşunu ve biçimin özel ad işlevini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İkinci çıplak biçimin belirli bir vadiye gönderme yaptığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Göndergenin vadi oluşunu ve biçimin özel ad işlevini korur.
İlk göndergenin bir dağ olduğunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Biçimin belirli bir yerin özel adı oluşunu ve vadi kullanımını yitirir.
error_profile.adds: Herhangi bir dağı bildiren genel ad kapsamını ekler.
error_profile.collision: Özel adı yer türünün genel adıyla karıştırır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; diğer yer adı dalları yalnızca özel ad olma alanını paylaşır ve farklı göndergelere sahiptir. Aynı kökün sevgi, dilek ve put adı dalları da yazılış dışında anlam sınırını aydınlatacak bir ortaklık sunmaz.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الود اسما لجبل معروف وودان اسما لواد معروف كما ورد في المادة.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه المحبة أو التمني أو الصنم أو الوتد.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الود: جبل معروف؛ وودان: واد معروف (jamhara)؛ هو اسم جبل (sihah)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi biçimi, tapınılan belirli bir putun özel adı olarak açıklar; toplu aktarım bu adı farklı eski topluluklarla ilişkilendirir ve ondan türetilmiş bir kişi adını da kaydeder. Kişi adı, put adı çekirdeğine bağlı bir adlandırmadır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal belirli putlara verilmiş özel adı ve bu addan türeyen kişi adını kapsar; putların genel adını veya başka put adlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, çıplak biçimdeki put adını çekirdek tutar ve bu addan kurulan kişi adını bağımlı bir kullanım olarak ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Biçimin, farklı eski toplulukların tapındığı belirli bir puta verilen özel ad olarak kullanılmasıdır. Bu put adından kurulan kişi adı, çekirdeğe bağlı ayrı bir adlandırmadır.

facets.statement: Biçimin tapınılan belirli bir puta verilen özel ad olarak kullanılması.
Aynı özel adın toplu aktarımda farklı eski toplulukların putlarıyla ilişkilendirilmesi.
Putun özel adından bir kişi adı kurulması.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar biçimin bir putun özel adı olduğu konusunda birleşir. Toplu aktarım bu adı farklı eski topluluklarla ilişkilendirir ve ayrıca put adından kurulmuş bir kişi adını kaydeder.

concept_gloss.applicability: Biçimin tapınılan belirli bir puta verilen özel ad olduğu çekirdek kullanımını karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Göndergenin put oluşunu ve biçimin özel ad işlevini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Belirli putun kimliğinin adın yüzey biçimi verilmeden açıklanması gereken bağlamlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Tapınılan belirli put göndergesini ve adlandırma işlevini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bu putun adına bağlanan kişi adı

error_profile.preserves: Göndergenin tapınılan bir put olduğunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Biçimin belirli bir putun özel adı oluşunu yitirir.
error_profile.adds: Bütün putları kapsayan genel ad anlamını ekler.
error_profile.collision: Özel adı put türünün genel adıyla karıştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirli bir puta verilen özel adı ve bu addan kurulan kişi adını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Putların yanı sıra kötü yola sürükleyen kişi veya varlıklar için kullanılan genel bir sınıf adıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: özel put adı ile genel kötü güç adı
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da Tanrı dışında tapınılan bir varlığa gönderme yapabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal belirli bir putun özel adıdır. Komşu dal ise putla sınırlı olmayan, kötü yola sürükleyen veya tapınılan çeşitli varlıkları kapsayan genel bir sınıf adı olduğundan olağan kullanımda yerine geçemez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal ayrı bir puta verilen özel adı ve ondan kurulan kişi adını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Karşı dal başka bir puta verilmiş ayrı bir özel addır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da eski toplulukların taptığı putlara verilmiş özel adlardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Ortaklık yalnızca aynı adlandırma alanında bulunmalarıdır. Göndergeleri farklı putlar olduğu için adlar birbirinin yerine kullanılamaz ve anlam çekirdekleri özdeş sayılmaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirli bir putun özel adını bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Oyulmuş veya işlenmiş insan biçimli nesneyi, resmi ve bunlara benzetilen varlıkları genel olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da insan biçimi verilmiş ve put olarak kullanılabilen bir nesneye gönderme yapabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın belirleyici özelliği belirli bir putun özel adı olmasıdır. Komşu dal nesnenin işlenmiş görüntü veya yontu oluşunu anlatan daha geniş bir ortak ad alanına sahiptir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; yayımlanan karşılaştırmalar özel put adını genel tapınma sınıfından, başka bir put adından ve yontu ortak adından ayırır. Kalan adaylar başka put adları, tapınmayla ilişkili eylem ve nesneler veya aynı yazılışın ilgisiz dallarıdır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ود أو ودا اسما لصنم، وخاصة الصنم المذكور لقوم نوح أو لقبائل العرب، وما ربطته المصادر بالتسمية بعبد ود.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه المودة العامة ولا التمني ولا الوتد ولا الموضع.
branches.source_phrase_ar: وود: صنم هكذا فسر في التنزيل؛ وقد قالوا ود أيضا (jamhara)؛ وود: صنم كان لقوم نوح ثم صار لكلاب (sihah)؛ الود صنم كان لقوم نوح، وكان لقريش صنم يدعونه ودا؛ ومنه سمي عبد ود (tahdhib)؛ الود: صنم سمي بذلك (mufradat)

root_profile.summary: Kök, sevgi ve gönülden yakınlık çekirdeğiyle bunun bir sonucun gerçekleşmesini dilemeye uzanan anlam akrabasını bir araya getirir. Kazık, dağ ya da vadi özel adı ve put özel adı dalları ise bu duygusal çekirdekten bağımsız adlandırmalardır.

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.
